fixed.summary: A category name under a bar stays on one line, on the same baseline as the others: with more than eight bars every other bar is named, and every third in a chart narrower than 520 px, instead of the names wrapping to two lines.

A figure is never cut with an ellipsis. In a narrow shell the value keeps its whole width and the name gives way. The tracks prop documents that a numeric column's track holds its widest figure in text-scaled units (calc(96 * var(--font-step-px))), so it grows with the player's text size.
